entities.name: Query CTP synthase
observations: 542 aa protein; predicted molecular weight 59.93 kDa and theoretical pI 6.02.
Full-length homology to reviewed CTP synthases: 89.5%, 87.8%, and 81.6% identity with 100% query coverage; E-value 0.
Pfam domains: CTP_synth_N (PF06418) at residues 3–264 and GATase (PF00117) at residues 301–533; Peptidase_C26 hit is weaker and may reflect domain overlap or remote similarity.
Likely homotetrameric enzyme catalyzing ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP using glutamine or ammonia.
Likely participates in de novo CTP biosynthesis and pyrimidine metabolism; cytosolic bacterial enzyme by homology.
Exact substrate preference between glutamine and free ammonia is not established from sequence alone.

entities.name: UTP amination to CTP
observations: Reference reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+), Rhea RHEA:26426.
An ammonia-dependent alternative is also annotated: UTP + NH4(+) + ATP → CTP + ADP + phosphate, Rhea RHEA:16597.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: The enzyme is associated with pyrimidine metabolism and the de novo CTP biosynthetic process, specifically the conversion of UTP to CTP.
GO terms from close reviewed homologs include CTP synthase activity (GO:0003883), glutaminase activity (GO:0004359), and de novo CTP biosynthetic process (GO:0044210).
